sides.name: Order
points: Defeat your enemies with style and honor
You'd probably find Lord Shimura here

classes.name: General
classes.description: A born leader. Specializes in buffing their team and inspiring cooperation among their troops

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: A guardian of the faith. This class specializes in protecting their allies and maintaining harmony in their battlefield

classes.name: Samurai
classes.description: A warrior of Honor. This class specializes in blade and swordplay. This class gets stronger the more they fight

sides.name: Balance
points: Fight with confusion and honor? Wait that doesn't make sense....
Make both sides lose their mind

classes.name: Mystic Bladeslinger
classes.description: A swordsman adept in the magical arts. Deals massive ammounts of damage quickly. Low defensive capabilities

classes.name: Bandit
classes.description: A class specifically designed for the element of surprise. Deals insanely high damage, but very low defense

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A skilled magician. This class specializes in spells and potions.

classes.name: Soothsayer
classes.description: A master of confusion and deception. This class specializes in moral disruption and manipulating others.

classes.name: Dead Knight
classes.description: A lone wolf in battle. Low damage and high defensive capabilities, however, this class excels in draining the life force of their enemies

classes.name: Shadow Warrior
classes.description: A warrior of shadows. This class specializes in shadow attacks and defensive abilities. This class gets stronger the more they fight
